name: Dominator
notes: The line has two jobs: clan/party buffer with off-heals, and mass debuffer. It does weak damage.

In the owner's party with board buffs most Pa'agrio 20-min buffs are redundant (0.2). What matters: Seal debuffs on raids and big pulls, Heart of Pa'agrio and Chain Heal as off-heals, CP buffs, and the 3rd-class unique buffs.
The Pa'agrio party buffs only reach party and clan members (PARTY_PLEDGE).
The 76-85 table lists only the Dominator additions: the Overlord rows are kept below (why: "kept from the 40-75 Overlord table").

rows.trig: Pull with Chill Flame (DoT) or Venom, then Life Drain, then melee with a blunt or staff.
Or pull with Venom (poison DoT), then Life Drain, then melee.
Stun Attack (blunt): the melee part, after Life Drain.
Aura Sink (MP burn) only against casters with MP.
Chant of Life (party HoT 15 s) when >= 2 members < 70 %. (Raid sequence step 7: not on Destroyers in their Frenzy window unless HP < 15 %.)
Board-duplicate chant (Chant of Battle = board Might): only if the board buff is missing.
Board-duplicate chant (Chant of Fire = board Magic Barrier): only if the board buff is missing.
Board-duplicate chant (Chant of Shielding = board Shield): only if the board buff is missing.
Board-duplicate chant (Flame Chant = board Acumen): only if the board buff is missing.
Board-duplicate chant (Soul Shield = board Shield): only if the board buff is missing.
CC: Seal of Slow on an add while the party kills the main target.
CC: Dreaming Spirit: sleep an add while the party kills the main target.
Unique buff, 20 min: Soul of Pa'agrio (M.Atk x1.75, M.Def x1.3). Keep up on the party, always.
Unique buff, 20 min: Eye of Pa'agrio (accuracy +4, crit received x0.7). Keep up on the party, always.

when.text: no Doomcryer Chant of Victory 1363 and no Titan Over the Body 536 in the party

rows.trig: 5-min burst: Victory of Pa'agrio (40 Spirit Ore; MULTI_BUFF) before a raid, or before an epic/hard pull. Only if no Doomcryer Chant of Victory and no Titan using Over the Body.
5-min burst: Pa'agrio's Fist (+800 Max CP, 20 Spirit Ore) before a raid, or before an epic/hard pull.

when.text: no Chant of Spirit 1362 (or board Arcane Protection) is on

rows.trig: 5-min burst: Pa'agrio's Emblem before a raid or a hard pull, only if no Chant of Spirit is on (RESIST_DEBUFF_DISPEL).
Seal of Despair (Atk.Spd/crit/M.Def x0.7, accuracy -6, P.Atk x0.9, speed x0.8; 30 s, 30 s reuse): raid or champion pull, on cooldown while >= 1 big target is in r200.

when.text: the party is taking heavy melee damage

rows.trig: Seal of Blockade (blocks normal attacks of <= 10 enemies for 10 s, 75 s reuse) when the party is taking heavy melee damage.

Chain Heal (83: heals up to 10 friends <= 300 around the target by 30 % Max HP, 4 Spirit Ore) when >= 3 members < 50 %. (Raid sequence step 7: not on Destroyers in their Frenzy window unless HP < 15 %.)

when.text: I am nuking with Steal Essence 1245

rows.trig: Arcane Power (M.Atk x1.3, drains HP) only while nuking with Steal Essence. Off otherwise.
Never: Seal of Disease (PvP).
Never: Flames of Invincibility (manual, clan only).
